posts.title: Posted my PM lathe in the machine for sale section here cheap - no views.
posts.text: hello all, I posted an un-used PM 1236T in the machine for sale section here and its gotten no attention, I'm looking to down size so I also offered to trade for a smaller PM machine with a little cash. I'm thinking very few people are looking at the members for sale section, I know the unregistered public cant see it, which was the point - Id rather take a lose and have a needy member here get a great deal. at this point though I'm thinking of selling off forum so i can get a new PM... posts.title: Turnkey in Michigan — ICE-Built 12' Hot Water Trailer + Soft Wash + Customer List — $15,500
posts.text: Selling my turnkey 12’ tandem pressure washing and soft wash trailer. Milford, MI. Professionally built by Industrial Cleaning Equipment (ICE) and serviced by Hotsy Midwest in Livonia. Everything works — hook it up and go to work. Pressure-Pro hot water unit, Honda GX630, 5.5 GPM @ 3,500 PSI — only 227 hours 12V soft wash (Everflo 5.5 GPM) plus a spare pump head still in the box 550-gal buffer tank and two 35-gal chemical tanks 4 hose reels: 2 pressure washing, 1 soft wash, 1 fill hose Diamond plate toolbox on the tongue 2 surface cleaners 3 wands (3’, 6’, 9’) Extra hoses, fittings, tips, tool
